## Review checklist

- [ ] The linked leaf issue was `Ready` and passed the separate scope, acceptance, validation, dependency, and parent checks before claiming.
- [ ] The issue metadata follows [ISSUE_TRIAGE.md](../ISSUE_TRIAGE.md).
- [ ] The change satisfies its acceptance criteria. Containers are referenced, never closed by this PR.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior, or this pull request explains why no test applies.
- [ ] Public contracts and operator workflows have matching documentation.
- [ ] The pull-request title follows Conventional Commits.
- [ ] No secret, account ID, personal address, domain, state, or plan was added.
